From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: dedicated throughput/latency sizing for Ledgerly

Hi Erin — great call today, thanks for walking us through Ledgerly's call-routing use case. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the dedicated capacity sizing session (technical deep dive):

Key notes from discovery:
- Primary workload: real-time call transcription + post-call summarization (peak 1k concurrent calls across regions).
- Target P95 latency: <120ms token latency for streaming transcripts; end-to-end summary turnaround ~3–5s for 30s clips.
- Preferred models: open-model stack (local quantized variants) — you asked about quantization trade-offs for throughput.
- Security: VPC private deployment preferred; SOC2 evidence will be part of procurement.

What we need for the sizing call:
1) A short load profile (attached) filled with peak concurrency, typical seq lengths, and expected qps for embeddings/summary jobs.
2) Sample prompt mix (percent of streaming vs batch summaries).
3) Stakeholders to join (ops/dev, security, and a triage owner).

Proposed 60–75 minute slots (all PT) — pick one or propose alternatives:
- Thu Mar 4, 10:00–11:15 PT
- Fri Mar 5, 14:00–15:15 PT
- Tue Mar 9, 08:30–09:45 PT

Attached: ledgerly_load_profile_v2.xlsx (load template), mutual_action_plan_ledgerly.docx (draft MAP).

Next steps: if one of those slots works, we'll send a calendar invite and an agenda (throughput targets, quantization/latency tradeoffs, fallback routing). If not, share 2x slots and your timezone and we'll match.

Thanks — looking forward to the sizing workshop.

— Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Thanks Vivek — helpful recap and thanks to Ben and Grace for joining the call. A few quick answers and a request: 

- We're based in ET (Eastern). Peak concurrency is closer to 1,100 calls at peak, not 1,000 — apologies for rounding on the call.
- Typical streaming window is 20–45s with average 28s; summaries are generated immediately after call end.
- We'll need the VPC/on-prem pricing addendum for the MAP before the sizing session (security will want that).

Slots: Fri Mar 5 14:00–15:15 PT works for our team if you send an invite.

For the preparatory asks, I'll have our lead platform engineer (cc'd platform@ledgerly.com) drop a filled version of the load template by EOD Thu Mar 4. Any specific fields you want prioritized?

Erin
